title: Agents
tagline: Function calling, agent loops, planning, memory, code execution, multi-agent systems and agent security
summary: Language models become agents when they can act: call tools, run code, browse and operate computers over many steps. This course covers function calling, agent loops and planning, memory and context management, code and computer use, multi-agent systems, the evaluation of agents, and the security risks of autonomous action.

overview: Agents are systems that plan, act, and reason with external tools. This course covers the agent loop, tool use, and evaluation of autonomous LLM systems.
The key insight is that agents combine reasoning with action: the model plans, executes, observes results, and revises.
outcomes: Explain the agent loop: observe, plan, act, reflect.
Describe tool use and function-calling interfaces.
Evaluate agent systems on task completion and safety.
Analyze agent failures and failure recovery strategies.
